# API documentation

Start with the [API index](summary.md) or [setup and placeholder guide](usage.md).

Endpoint pages show observed hosts and link canonical definitions and recordings. Expand request recipes, full parameter values, response shapes and capture headers when needed. Authentication and requiredness are only asserted when supported by evidence.

Generated by `apic render --docs`. Update canonical inputs or the renderer and regenerate. Page paths mirror canonical endpoint directories: `apis/catalog/items/` becomes `catalog/items.md` here.
